senses.gloss: तद्- + अन्त तद्- + अन्त, adj. finding its end thereby, Hit. i. d. 85.
तद्-अर्थ + म् तद्-अर्थ + म्, adv. therefore, Rām. 1, 73, 4.
तद्- + अर्धिक तद्- + अर्धिक, adj. half that (time), Man. 3, 1.
तद्- + अवस्थ तद्- + अवस्थ, adj., f. था, being in this state.
तद्- + गत तद्- + गत, adj. 1. turned on him, her, it, that, Rām. 1, 2, 30. 2. only turned, Lass. 32, 12.

तद् तद्, except the nom. sing. m. and f., the base of the m. and n. and most derivatives is त, of the f. ता; the nom. sing. m. is सस्, f. सा.
 I. third personal pronoun,
 1. He, she, it, that, Man. 2, 234; 8, 11.
 2. Combined with the pronouns of the first, second, and third persons, Here, MBh. 1, 6415; 5, 5957; Hiḍ. 1, 38.
 3. Combined with the relative pronoun,
 a. Without a special signification, MBh. 7, 427.
 b. Every one, MBh. 13, 1674; whoever, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2429.
 c. with वा, This or that, Man. 12, 68.
 4. Repeated, This and that, Man. 12, 74; with following एव, The same, Rām. 3, 50, 28.
 5. यद्-यद्--तद्-तद्, Whatever, that, Man. 4, 159.
 II. n. The universe, Rām. 6, 102, 25.
 III. acc. sing. n. तद्, adverbially,
 1. Then, Pañc. 48, 3.
 2. Therefore, Man. 9, 41.
 IV. instr. तेन,
 1. Thus, Man. 4, 178.
 2. Therefore, Man. 7, 36.
 V. abl. तस्मात्, Therefore, Man. 1, 108.
 --Cf. ὁ, ἡ, τό; Lat. te, ta, tud in iste, etc.; Goth. sa, so, thata; A.S. se, seo, thaet.

तदा त + दा, see तद्, adv.
 1. Then, [] Nal. 1, 25; at that time, Man. 1, 52.
 2. From that time, MBh. 13, 2231.
तदात्व तदा + त्व, n. Present time, Man. 7, 163.
तदानीम् तदानीम्, i. e. तद + न + ई + म्, adv. Then, at that time, Draup. 6, 10.

तदीय तद् + ईय, adj.
 1. Belonging, or referring, or proper, to him, her, it, that, Rām. 4, 21, 35; Pañc. i. d. 224. Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 8.
 2. Such, Kathās. 3, 47.

तद्वत् तद् + वत्, adv.
 1. Thus, Pañc. ii. d. 62.
 2. Thus also, Pañc. i. d 254.
 3. And, Kathās. 6, 48.
तद्वत्ता तद्वत् + ता, f. Harmony, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 8.
तद्वन्त् तद् + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Possessed of that (i. e. the previously mentioned उद्भूत-रूप), Bhāṣāp. 53.
तादात्म्य तादात्म्य, i. e. तद्-आत्मन् + य, n. Identity, Bhāg. P. 5, 1, 27.
तादृक्ष तादृक्ष, i. e. तद्-दृश् + स, adj. Such one, Rājat. 4, 242.

तादृश् तादृश्, i. e. तद्-दृश्, adj.
 1. Such one, Rājat. 5, 425.
 2. Equal, Pañc. 38, 15; 19.
 --Cf. Lat. talis, and see the next.

तादृश तादृश, i. e. तद्-दृश् + अ, adj., f. शी.
 1. Such like, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 13.
 2. Such one, Man. 5, 34.
 3. Equal, Bhāg. P. 4, 27, 14.
 5. With preceding यादृश, Indiscriminate, Pañc. i. d. 435; compounded, MBh. 13, 5847.
 --Cf. τηλίκος.
तद्- + देश्य तद्- + देश्य, adj. being of the same country, MBh. 12, 6305.
तद्- + यथा तद्- + यथा, adv. namely, Pañc. 3, 10; 7, 15; for, Utt. Rāmac. 35, 17.
तद्- + विद् तद्- + विद्, adj. knowing that, Vikr. d. 40.
तद्- + विध तद्- + विध, adj. 1. proportioned to that, Man. 2, 112. 2. of that kind, Ragh. 2, 22.
तादृग्विध तादृग्विध, i. e. तादृश्-, adj. being in such a situation, Kathās. 22, 231.
तद्-वृत्ति तद्-वृत्ति, adj. abiding in that, i. e. as शब्दत्व in शब्द, Bhāṣāp. 60, cf. 22.
तदीय- + स्थान तदीय- + स्थान, n. its place, Vikr. 71, 11.
